sources: Source: IronManCharacter, ArenaFeel, StoryDirector, SuitUpCinematic, ContribLighting, ArenaGameUserSettings (read only)

s35_spherical_primes.label: Modern S35 spherical primes (Master-Prime class)

anamorphic_2x_primes.flare_character: horizontal blue streaks + oval ghosts (anamorphic option below)

shot_types._convention: Gameplay cameras are UCameraComponent with a HORIZONTAL FOV; the user's FieldOfView setting (ArenaGameUserSettings, default 95, slider 70-120) stays authoritative. Shot types are expressed as multipliers/offsets on it plus the full-frame (36 mm wide) equivalent focal length so cinematography and gameplay talk the same units: f_ff = 18 / tan(hFOV/2).

gameplay_third_person.recommended_hfov_rule: user_fov - 10 (85 at default 95 = 19.6 mm FF); 90 deg at 4.2 m stretches the suit at frame edges
gameplay_third_person.depth_of_field: off (DepthOfFieldFocalDistance overridden to 0). At 18-20 mm FF and f/4+ the hyperfocal distance is ~3 m, so a real lens would render everything past the suit sharp.

epic_optional.note: only near geometry (<~3 m) visibly blurs; hyperfocal at 22.5 mm f/2.8 is ~6 m

aim.camera_rotation_blur: recommend off while aiming (needs C++ bCameraMotionBlur=false, see notes)

flight.note: non-physical perceptual cue (a real camera does not widen with speed); kept modest. Reduced-motion: x0.5.

spring_arm.note: slight rotation lag reads as a chase drone instead of a rigid boom

helmet_hud_pov.why: EDITH's visor widget already adds barrel warp (K1 .06/K2 .015), chromatic edge split 1.5 px, 0.02 noise and a warning vignette (contrib/edith/hud_spec.md). Adding scene-level vignette, CA, grain or lens distortion would double them. The visor is a display, not a lens, so the scene behind it should look clean.
helmet_hud_pov.exposure: same histogram as gameplay; consider AutoExposureMeterMask (center-weighted) so HUD-lit visor frame does not meter

cutscene.focal_scale_rule: f_body = f_s35 * (SensorWidth * SqueezeFactor / 24.89) keeps StoryDirector horizontal framing on non-S35 filmbacks

aperture_rule_by_shot.ecu: max(preset, f/2.8 S35-equiv) - wider than that leaves eyelashes soft

cutscene.dof_equivalence: N_body = N_s35 * SensorWidth/24.89 gives the same DOF for the same framing

focus.FocusMethod: Tracking (face/eye socket) or Manual from look-at distance

cutscene.shutter: 180 deg at 24 fps (1/48); ruins + titan_battlefield 90 deg (1/96, combat staccato) - from lighting_presets

rooftops.nd_filter: ND 2.1 (7 stops); UE has no ND, so it is folded into CameraISO = 800 / 2^7 = 6.25

city.nd_filter: ND 2.4 (8 stops); UE has no ND, so it is folded into CameraISO = 800 / 2^8 = 3.125

ruins.nd_filter: ND 1.5 (5 stops); UE has no ND, so it is folded into CameraISO = 800 / 2^5 = 25

titan_battlefield.nd_filter: ND 0.9 (3 stops); UE has no ND, so it is folded into CameraISO = 800 / 2^3 = 100

finale.nd_filter: ND 1.2 (4 stops); UE has no ND, so it is folded into CameraISO = 800 / 2^4 = 50

city_overcast.nd_filter: ND 1.8 (6 stops); UE has no ND, so it is folded into CameraISO = 800 / 2^6 = 12.5

model.units: EV100 (r.DefaultFeature.AutoExposure.ExtendDefaultLuminanceRange=True, so Min/MaxBrightness and HistogramLogMin/Max are EV100)
model.camera_ev100: log2(N^2 / t) - log2(ISO / 100); ND folded into effective ISO

histogram_range.why: covers city_night (3.9) to sunlit city (15.6) with >2 EV headroom both ends

workshop_to_outdoors.volume: bounded PPV at the hangar door / exit tunnel, Priority 1, BlendRadius 300 cm
workshop_to_outdoors.why: eyes/cameras adapt to light in seconds and to dark much slower; 2.5 EV/s reads as a real exposure pull without a white-out longer than ~1 s

flash_events.explosions_lightning: keep AutoExposureHighPercent 98.3 so small bright VFX are ignored; combat overlay drops SpeedUp to 2.0 to stop pumping on sub-0.3 s flashes
flash_events.unibeam_pov: flash lasts 0.9 s; at SpeedUp 2 the camera pulls ~0.5 EV - intended

eye_adaptation_cvars.note: verify name/default in 5.8; controls where the speed switches from linear to exponential

bias_curve_optional.property: AutoExposureBiasCurve (CurveFloat, x = average scene EV100, y = bias EV)
bias_curve_optional.why: night stays night (real cameras/eyes do not lift a moonlit street to mid-grey); midday snow/sky gets +0.3
bias_curve_optional.asset: /Game/Contrib/Vison/Camera/C_AutoExposureBias (create in editor; not created by script)

exposure.meter_mask_optional: AutoExposureMeterMask: centre-weighted radial texture (centre 1.0, edge 0.35) for helmet POV

Epic.cutscene: FUSION (verify in 5.8 - fall back to BILATERAL)

exposure.cutscene: AEM_Manual + AutoExposureApplyPhysicalCameraExposure from the cutscene camera triangle (cutscene_packages)

cutscene_spec.real_reference: 0.3-1.0 px lateral CA at frame edge at 1080p for cine primes
cutscene_spec.status: INERT today: DefaultScalability sets r.SceneColorFringeQuality=0 on every tier and ApplyPhotorealGrade forces 0 on cine cameras too

vignette.VignetteType: COSINE_FOURTH_LAW (5.8: physically based cos^4 falloff; fall back to OVAL if unavailable)
vignette.rule_cutscene: environment value (lighting_presets), which matches ~0.8-1.2 stops natural falloff wide open

gameplay_all_tiers.why: threshold -1 = energy-conserving (every pixel scatters a little), like real veiling glare

cutscene_Epic.kernel: engine default; upgrade = measured 1024^2 EXR kernel per lens set (9/11/7-blade starbursts)

anamorphic_option.note: image-based flare only; a true anamorphic streak needs a convolution kernel (Epic FFT) or a VFX sprite (Ultron's domain)

film_grain.model: digital sensor noise: strongest in shadows

lens_distortion.option_A: Lens Distortion / CameraCalibrationCore plugin (Brown-Conrady k1,k2,p1,p2,k3 per lens set below) - NOT enabled in IronManArena.uproject
lens_distortion.option_B: ST-map displacement material as a post-process blendable (BL_SceneColorAfterTonemapping is wrong for distortion; use BeforeTranslucency/ReplacingTonemapper-safe pass)
lens_distortion.helmet_pov: never (EDITH visor warp already does this)

depth_of_field.gameplay: off in third person, flight and helmet POV; optional subtle aim DOF on Epic (see shot_types.aim)
depth_of_field.cutscene: cinematic: per-shot aperture rules, focus tracking with smoothing, blade count from lens set
depth_of_field.DepthOfFieldMatteBoxFlags: unset (no matte box occlusion of bokeh)

per_object_vs_camera.per_object: always on (velocity buffer); MotionBlurPerObjectSize 0 = no minimum size (all objects)
per_object_vs_camera.camera: on in third person and flight; recommend OFF in aim and helmet POV via FSceneView.bCameraMotionBlur=false from a custom UGameViewportClient (C++; code owner). Without it, use MotionBlurAmount x0.7 there.

motion_blur.why_target_fps_60: TargetFPS 60 locks blur length to a 1/120 s shutter regardless of the real frame rate (dynamic res keeps ~60 on High); at 30-45 fps blur would otherwise stretch
motion_blur.reduced_motion: player toggle bMotionBlur already exists; reduced-motion users also get camera blur off

tiers._label: GPU ms on RTX 2070 SUPER @1080p (High 75% screen percentage) - ESTIMATES, not measured
